Document 6487: Google search reveals names of rape victims
Google removes predictions which are sexually explicit, hateful, violent or dangerous
谷歌移除涉及性露骨、仇恨、暴力或危险的预测结果
Google's auto-complete and related search functions are revealing the identity of rape victims who have been granted anonymity.
The issue was discovered in a Times newspaper investigation , externalof several prominent sexual assault cases.
谷歌的自动补全和相关搜索功能泄露了已获匿名保护的强奸受害者的身份。
Searches for attackers or alleged attackers automatically reveal the names of the women they have been accused of raping.
Google said it had removed all examples it had been "made aware of".
这一问题是在《泰晤士报》对几起备受关注的性侵案件进行调查时发现的。
The firm told the BBC: "We don't allow these kind of auto-complete predictions or related searches that violate laws or our own policies.
"We encourage people to send us feedback about any sensitive or bad predictions."
搜索施暴者或涉嫌施暴者时，会自动显示被指控强奸的女性的姓名。
Rape charity, The Survivors Trust, told the Times it was "beyond shocking" that Google's search engine threw up the names of victims.
Google recently expanded its removals policy to cover predictions in search which "disparage victims of violence and atrocities".
谷歌表示，已移除所有其“知悉”的相关案例。
Google's auto-complete predictions and related searches are automatically generated based on popular or trending searches.风险源
In the case of information about rape victims, it is likely that the suggestions appeared following searches on victims' names which may have been illegally exposed on social media.
该公司告诉BBC：“我们不允许此类违反法律或我们自身政策的自动补全预测或相关搜索。”
The Times found that, in the case of an alleged rape, typing the defendant's name plus a common search term brought up the alleged victim's name.
In another case, the same search also produced a name and home town.
“我们鼓励人们就任何敏感或不良预测向我们反馈。”
It also found that searching for a victim's name brought up the abuser's name as a related search.
Google does have systems which automatically catch inappropriate suggestions in search but it processes billions of searches each day, meaning some will fall through the net.
强奸受害者慈善机构“幸存者信托”告诉《泰晤士报》，谷歌搜索引擎显示出受害者的姓名“令人极其震惊”。
The firm also co-operates with courts to help prevent sensitive predictions from appearing in search.
Victims in sexual offence cases have automatic lifelong anonymity, even if the accused is acquitted. Breaching this carries fines of up to £5,000.
谷歌最近扩大了其移除政策范围，涵盖搜索中“贬低暴力和暴行受害者”的预测结果。
According to the Times, at least nine people have been convicted for posting names of victims on social media.
Document 674: Algorithmic Defamation: The Case of the Shameless Autocomplete
Note: A version of the following also appears on the Tow Center blog.
注：下文的一个版本也发布在Tow中心博客上。
In Germany, a man recently won a legal battle with Google over the fact that when you searched for his name, the autocomplete suggestions connected him to “scientology” and “fraud,” — two things that he felt had defamatory insinuations. As a result of losing the case, Google is now compelled to remove defamatory suggestions from autocomplete results when notified, in Germany at least.
Court cases arising from autocomplete defamation aren’t just happening in Germany though. In other European countries like Italy, France, and Ireland, to as wide afield as Japan and Australia people (and corporations) have brought suit alleging these algorithms defamed them by linking their names to everything from crime and fraud to bankruptcy or sexual conduct. In some cases such insinuations can have real consequences for finding jobs or doing business. New services, such as brand.com’s “Google Suggest Plan” have even arisen to help people manipulate and thus avoid negative connotations in search autocompletions.
在德国，一名男子最近赢得了与谷歌的法律诉讼，起因是当搜索他的名字时，自动补全建议将他关联到“科学教”和“欺诈”——他认为这两件事具有诽谤性的暗示。由于输掉了官司，谷歌现在被迫在接到通知后从自动补全结果中移除诽谤性建议，至少在德国是这样。
The Berkman Center’s Digital Media Law Project (DMLP) defines a defamatory statement generally as, “a false statement of fact that exposes a person to hatred, ridicule or contempt, lowers him in the esteem of his peers, causes him to be shunned, or injures him in his business or trade.” By associating a person’s name with some unsavory behavior it would seem indisputable that autocomplete algorithms can indeed defame people.风险
So if algorithms like autocomplete can defame people or businesses, our next logical question might be to ask how to hold those algorithms accountable for their actions. Considering the scale and difficulty of monitoring such algorithms, one approach would be to use more algorithms to keep tabs on them and try to find instances of defamation hidden within their millions (or billions) of suggestions.
因自动补全诽谤引发的诉讼并不仅仅发生在德国。在其他欧洲国家如意大利、法国和爱尔兰，远至日本和澳大利亚，人们（以及公司）已提起诉讼，指控这些算法将他们的名字与从犯罪、欺诈到破产或性行为等各种事情联系起来，从而构成了诽谤。在某些情况下，这种暗示会对求职或经商产生实际后果。甚至出现了新的服务，如brand.com的“谷歌建议计划”，帮助人们操纵并从而避免搜索自动补全中的负面联想。
To try out this approach I automatically collected data on both Google and Bing autocompletions for a number of different queries relating to public companies and politicians. I then filtered these results against keyword lists relating to crime and sex in order to narrow in on potential cases of defamation. I used a list of the corporations on the S&P 500 to query the autocomplete APIs with the following templates, where “X” is the company name: “X,” “X company,” “X is,” “X has,” “X company is,” and “X company has.” And I used a list of U.S. congresspeople from the Sunlight Foundation to query for each person’s first and last name, as well as adding either “representative” or “senator” before their name. The data was then filtered using a list of sex-related keywords, and words related to crime collected from the Cambridge US dictionary in order to focus on a smaller subset of the almost 80,000 autosuggestions retrieved.
Among the corporate autocompletions that I filtered and reviewed, there were twenty-four instances that could be read as statements or assertions implicating the company in everything from corruption and scams to fraud and theft. For instance, querying Bing for “Torchmark” returns as the second suggestion, “torchmark corporation job scam.” Without really digging deeply it’s hard to tell if Torchmark corporation is really involved in some form of scam, or if there’s just some rumors about scam-like emails floating around. If those rumors are false, this could indeed be a case of defamation against the company. But this is a dicey situation for Bing, since if they filtered out a rumor that turned out to be true it might appear they were trying to sweep a company’s unsavory activities under the rug. People would ask: Is Bing trying to protect this company? At the same time they would be doing a disservice to their users by not steering them clear of a scam.
伯克曼中心的数字媒体法律项目（DMLP）通常将诽谤性陈述定义为：“一种虚假的事实陈述，使人遭受仇恨、嘲笑或蔑视，降低其在同辈中的声誉，导致其被排斥，或在其商业或贸易中受到伤害。”通过将一个人的名字与某种不良行为联系起来，自动补全算法确实可以诽谤他人，这似乎是无可争辩的。
While looking through the autocompletions returned from querying for congresspeople it became clear that a significant issue here relates to name collisions. For relatively generic congressperson names like “Gerald Connolly” or “Joe Barton” there are many other people on the internet with the same names. And some of those people did bad things. So when you Google for “Gerald Connolly” one suggestion that comes up is “gerald connolly armed robbery,” not because Congressman Gerald Connolly robbed anyone but because someone else in Canada by the same name did. If you instead query for “representative Gerald Connolly” the association goes away; adding “representative” successfully disambiguates the two Connollys. The search engine has it tough though: Without a disambiguating term how should it know you’re looking for the congressman or a robber? There are other cases that may be more clear-cut instances of defamation, such as on Bing “Joe Barton” suggesting “joe barton scam” which was not corrected when adding the title “representative” to the front of the query. That seems to be more of a legitimate instance of defamation since even with the disambiguation it’s sti
Document 676: Google loses autocomplete defamation case in Italy
Google has lost a case in Italy over the defamatory nature of autocomplete suggestions, according to a lawyer for the complainant.
据原告律师称，谷歌在意大利输掉了一场关于自动补全建议诽谤性质的诉讼。
Google has lost a case in Italy over the defamatory nature of autocomplete suggestions. Credit: Google
On Tuesday, lead counsel Carlo Piana wrote on his blog that the Court of Milan has upheld its earlier decision to order Google to filter out libellous search suggestions.风险控制 These are the suggestions that pop up in Google's search input bar, proposing what the user might be wanting to search for.
谷歌在意大利输掉了一场关于自动补全建议诽谤性质的诉讼。图片来源：谷歌
People searching via Google for Piana's client, who remains publicly unnamed, were apparently presented with autocomplete suggestions including truffatore ("con man") and truffa ("fraud").
The order (PDF, in Italian) is dated 31 March, although Piana only made its contents public on Tuesday. Google lost its bid to claim the protection of the E-Commerce Directive's safe harbour provisions, which partly shields hosting and ISPs from liability for content held on or transmitted over their systems. However, the court viewed the autocomplete suggestions as being produced by Google itself.
周二，首席律师卡洛·皮亚纳在他的博客上写道，米兰法院维持了此前责令谷歌过滤诽谤性搜索建议的判决。这些建议会出现在谷歌的搜索输入栏中，提示用户可能想要搜索的内容。
Content filter
"Google argued that it could not be held liable because it is a hosting provider, but we showed that this is content produced by them (and by the way, they do filter out certain content, including terms that are known to be used to distribute copyright-infringing material), although through automated means," Piana wrote.
通过谷歌搜索皮亚纳客户的人，看到的自动补全建议中显然包括了“truffatore”（意为“骗子”）和“truffa”（意为“欺诈”）。该客户的姓名尚未公开。
The lawyer said the suit is "by no means an endorsement to censorship", as the allegations had been fully discussed with Google before the court action was even considered and only two phrases were put forward to be filtered out of autocomplete.
"All cases are different, therefore there is no assurance that similar cases would see the same outcome," Piana said. He added that this case had "caused a lot of trouble to the client, who has a public image both as an entrepreneur and provider of educational services in the field of personal finance".
该判决（PDF格式，意大利语）日期为3月31日，尽管皮亚纳直到周二才公开其内容。谷歌试图援引《电子商务指令》中的“避风港”条款进行抗辩，该条款部分免除托管服务商和互联网服务提供商对其系统上存储或传输内容的法律责任，但未能成功。然而，法院认为自动补全建议是由谷歌自己生成的。
In a statement on Tuesday, Google said it was "disappointed" by the Court of Milan's decision.
"We believe that Google should not be held liable for terms that appear in autocomplete as these are predicted by computer algorithms based on searches from previous users, not by Google itself," the company said. "We are currently reviewing our options."
内容过滤
This is not the first time Google has fallen foul of Italy's authorities. In February 2010, three Google executives were convicted in absentia over a video uploaded to the site, in which an autistic child was shown being bullied. In January this year, Italian authorities also forced Google to make concessions regarding Google News and AdSense, in order to close an antitrust investigation in the country.
Document 679: Australian to sue Google for defamation over search results
CANBERRA, Australia -- An Australian man who alleges Google defamed him on Wednesday won a court battle to sue the search engine giant. Milorad "Michael" Trkulja was shot in the back in 2004 in a restaurant in Melbourne, Australia's second largest city.
澳大利亚堪培拉——一名指控谷歌诽谤自己的澳大利亚男子于周三赢得了一场诉讼，得以起诉这家搜索引擎巨头。米洛拉德·“迈克尔”·特鲁尔贾于2004年在澳大利亚第二大城市墨尔本的一家餐厅背部中枪。
The Australian High Court unanimously ruled in favor of Trkulja, supporting his allegation that a Google search of his name could indicate to an ordinary person he was "somehow associated with the Melbourne criminal underworld."影响
Trkulja had successfully argued in the Victoria state Supreme Court in 2012 that Google defamed him by publishing photos of him linked to hardened criminals of Melbourne's underworld.
澳大利亚高等法院一致裁定特鲁尔贾胜诉，支持了他的主张，即搜索他的名字可能会让普通人认为他“与墨尔本黑社会有某种关联”。
The Power of Google
Four years later, the Victorian Court of Appeal overturned the decision, finding the case had no prospect of successfully proving defamation. The High Court disputed that ruling and ordered Google to pay Trkulja's legal costs.
特鲁尔贾曾于2012年在维多利亚州最高法院成功辩称，谷歌通过发布将他同墨尔本黑社会顽固罪犯联系在一起的照片对他构成了诽谤。
Google searches for "Melbourne criminal underworld photos" bring up images of Trkulja alongside gangland figures, his lawyer Guy Reynolds told the High Court in March.
However, Google's lawyers argued it would be "irrational" for someone to assume photos in a Google image search for underworld figures are all of criminals, because the same search would also bring up the Google logo, movie posters, images of crime victims and photos of actor Marlon Brando.
谷歌的力量
Trkulja is also claiming defamation around Google's "autocomplete" options for his name, which have included phrases like "is a former hit man," ''criminal" and "underworld."
How did Google get so big?
四年后，维多利亚州上诉法院推翻了这一判决，认为该案成功证明诽谤的可能性微乎其微。高等法院对这一裁决提出异议，并下令谷歌支付特鲁尔贾的诉讼费用。
However, the court heard autocomplete is an automatic function and that previous searches influence future suggestions.
The defamation suit is expected to go back to the Victoria Supreme Court for trial.
特鲁尔贾的律师盖·雷诺兹于3月告诉高等法院，在谷歌搜索“墨尔本黑社会照片”会显示出特鲁尔贾与黑帮人物并列的图片。
Trkulja said he would continue the legal action until he gets the result he wants, fearful someone will see the images and tell his grandchildren he's a hardened criminal.
"I will sue Google ... and I will sue them till they stop. I want them to block my pictures," he said. "I'm not a criminal, I've never been involved and I will make sure these people are not going to ruin my family - I have grandchildren," he added.
然而，谷歌的律师辩称，如果有人认为谷歌图片搜索中关于黑社会人物的照片全都是罪犯，那是“不理性的”，因为同样的搜索也会显示出谷歌标志、电影海报、犯罪受害者照片以及演员马龙·白兰度的照片。
Google said in a statement: "We will continue to defend the claim. We decline to comment further on ongoing legal matters."
Document 683: Federal Supreme Court: Google Liable for Defamatory Autocomplete Search Terms
This morning, the Federal Supreme Court (Bundesgerichtshof) has held Google liable for a functionality of its search engine, the autocomplete function. The claimants had requested that Google ceased the publication of autocomplete results that suggested “fraud” or “Scientology” as additional search terms when the claimants’ names were searched. Google will now have to stop the publication of such “predictions” if and when it has become aware that automatically created predictions infringe the rights of third parties.
今晨，联邦最高法院（Bundesgerichtshof）裁定谷歌因其搜索引擎的一项功能——自动补全功能——而承担责任。原告曾请求谷歌停止发布自动补全结果，这些结果在搜索原告姓名时会建议将“欺诈”或“山达基”作为附加搜索词。谷歌今后若知晓自动生成的预测结果侵犯了第三方权利，将必须停止发布此类“预测”。
The predictions of additional search terms are generated automatically by a Google algorithm, based inter alia on the search terms entered by Google users. Google has been using the function since April 2009.
Google has been taken to court across the globe on this issue, winning in Italy in March 2013, and loosing in Japan in April 2013, for example. Today’s ruling appears to be the first one from a court of last instance. And if Google were not enough to get the matter into the headlines: Germany’s former first lady, Bettina Wulff, had commenced a similar action, which had been stayed, pending the outcome in today’s case. Bettina Wulff is seeking to stop the publication of autocomplete results linking her to search words such as “escort” or ” red light”. Her case had triggered a broad debate about the legal limits on the publication of search results.
附加搜索词的预测是由谷歌算法根据谷歌用户输入的搜索词等因素自动生成的。谷歌自2009年4月起开始使用该功能。
The Court of Appeals (Oberlandesgericht) Köln had found, in the previous instance, in favour of Google. It did not attribute the “statements” generated by the autocomplete function to Google (“Den […] Ergänzungssuchbegriffen ist nicht der Charakter eigenständiger inhaltlicher Aussagen der Suchmaschine bzw. deren Betreibers […] beizumessen.”)
The Federal Supreme Court did not agree. Its line of arguments is as follows: The publication of predictions as a result of the autocomplete function constitutes a violation of personality rights (Persönlichkeitsrecht), if they imply a statement that is untrue. On the other hand, not every violation of personality rights by the search engine triggers Google’s liability. The autocomplete function per se is perfectly legal. The issue is the missing safeguard against the publication of results of a defamatory nature (“… dass sie keine hinreichenden Vorkehrungen getroffen hat, dass die von der Software generierten Suchvorschläge Rechte Dritter verletzen.”)
谷歌因该问题在全球各地被诉诸法庭，例如，2013年3月在意大利胜诉，2013年4月在日本败诉。今天的裁决似乎是来自终审法院的首例判决。如果谷歌本身还不足以让此事登上头条，那么德国前第一夫人贝蒂娜·伍尔夫（Bettina Wulff）也已提起了类似的诉讼，该案此前已中止审理，等待今天案件的判决结果。贝蒂娜·伍尔夫正寻求停止发布将她与“陪游”或“红灯”等搜索词联系起来的自动补全结果。她的案件曾引发了一场关于发布搜索结果法律界限的广泛辩论。
The Federal Supreme Court also does not find that there is a general duty to scrutinize the search results for potential infringements of third party rights prio to publication (“Der Betreiber einer Suchmaschine ist regelmäßig nicht verpflichtet, die […] Suchergänzungsvorschläge vorab auf etwaige Rechtsverletzungen zu überprüfen.”)
This duty is only triggered if and when Google becomes aware of a violation of third party rights. In practice, Google will now have to investigate the defamatory or slanderous nature of suggested search terms if a cease and desist letter comes in, and will then have to take appropriate action.
科隆上诉法院（Oberlandesgericht）在前一审级中作出了有利于谷歌的判决。该院并未将自动补全功能生成的“陈述”归因于谷歌（“Den […] Ergänzungssuchbegriffen ist nicht der Charakter eigenständiger inhaltlicher Aussagen der Suchmaschine bzw. deren Betreibers […] beizumessen.”）。
Technically, the claimants’ right to request Google to cease and desist is based on Sec. 823, 1004 German Civil Code (BGB) and Art. 1, 2, Basic Law (Grundgesetz), that is, on a combination of civil law tort concepts, and the fundamental rights of human dignity and personal freedom. The Federal Supreme Court does weight the respective rights of claimants on the one hand and Google’s rights, which also enjoy constitutional protection, and on balance, finds in favour of the claimants. I refrain from a personal comment on the matter, since my firm acts for one of the parties involved.
Share and Enjoy
联邦最高法院不予认同。其论证逻辑如下：如果自动补全功能生成的预测暗示了不真实的陈述，则发布此类预测构成对人格权（Persönlichkeitsrecht）的侵犯。另一方面，并非搜索引擎对人格权的每一次侵犯都会触发谷歌的责任。自动补全功能本身是完全合法的。问题在于缺乏针对发布诽谤性质结果的保障措施（“… dass sie keine hinreichenden Vorkehrungen getroffen hat, dass die von der Software generierten Suchvorschläge Rechte Dritter verletzen.”）。
Document 685: Google held to be a publisher of defamatory autocomplete and related search terms
The South Australian Supreme Court has found that Google published defamatory statements that appeared in autocomplete and related search terms on its search engine, after it received notice of the defamatory material and failed it remove it.
南澳大利亚最高法院裁定，谷歌在收到诽谤材料的通知后未能将其移除，因此发布了出现在其搜索引擎自动完成和相关搜索词中的诽谤陈述。
His Honour Justice Blue reasoned that the defamatory phrase was 'generated by Google programs as a result of Google's programming' and that 'the mere fact that the words are programmed to be generated because the user or others have previously searched for those words makes no difference' to the question of publication. His Honour decided that there was no reason why Google should not be held accountable for these 'publications' after it was put on notice by the plaintiff. It is worth noting that the plaintiff did not seek to argue that Google should be liable for the period prior to notification.
In his judgment, his Honour referred to the 'only authority' on this point as supporting this conclusion, being the decision of the High Court of Hong Kong in Dr Yeung Sau Shing Albert v Google Inc. In that case, the High Court dismissed an application by Google to have the proceeding stayed or dismissed on the basis that, among other things, the plaintiff had 'a good arguable case' that Google was the publisher of defamatory statements that appeared in Google Autocomplete and Related Search results.
布鲁法官推理认为，该诽谤短语是“由谷歌程序作为其编程的结果而生成的”，且“仅仅因为这些词语被编程为因用户或他人此前搜索过这些词语而生成，这一事实对发布的问题没有任何影响”。布鲁法官认为，在原告发出通知后，没有理由不让谷歌对这些“发布”行为承担责任。值得注意的是，原告并未主张谷歌应对通知前的时期承担责任。
His Honour Justice Blue also followed the reasoning of the Victorian Supreme Court in Trkulja v Google Inc LLC (No 5) and held that Google was the publisher of defamatory search results (comprising of the title, snippet and URL) after it received notification and failed to remove the defamatory results within a reasonable time.
A further hearing is scheduled to decide the remaining issues of the defences of triviality and time limitation, the application for an extension of time, causation and quantum of damages.
在其判决中，布鲁法官提及了关于这一点的“唯一权威判例”作为支持此结论的依据，即香港高等法院在“杨受成博士诉谷歌公司案”中的判决。在该案中，高等法院驳回了谷歌关于中止或驳回诉讼的申请，理由包括原告拥有“极具争议的案情”，证明谷歌是出现在谷歌自动完成和相关搜索结果中的诽谤陈述的发布者。
You can read the judgment in full here.

Document 3447: Tesla worker killed in fiery crash may be first ‘Full Self-Driving’ fatality
EVERGREEN, Colo.
科罗拉多州埃弗格林。
Hans von Ohain and Erik Rossiter were on their way to play golf one afternoon in 2022 when von Ohain's Tesla suddenly swerved off Upper Bear Creek Road. The car's driver-assistance software, Full Self-Driving, was struggling to navigate the mountain curves, forcing von Ohain repeatedly to yank it back on course.
"The first time it happened, I was like, 'Is that normal?'" recalled Rossiter, who described the five-mile drive on the outskirts of Denver as "uncomfortable." "And he was like, 'Yeah, that happens every now and then.'"
2022年的一天午后，汉斯·冯·奥恩和埃里克·罗西特正驱车前往打高尔夫球，当时冯·奥恩的特斯拉突然偏离了上贝尔溪路。该车的自动驾驶软件“全自动驾驶”在试图通过山路弯道时出现困难，迫使冯·奥恩反复将其拉回正道。
Hours later, on the way home, the Tesla Model 3 barreled into a tree and exploded in flames, killing von Ohain, a Tesla employee and devoted fan of CEO Elon Musk. Rossiter, who survived the crash, told emergency responders that von Ohain was using an "auto-drive feature on the Tesla" that "just ran straight off the road," according to a 911 dispatch recording obtained by The Washington Post. In a recent interview, Rossiter said he believes that von Ohain was using Full Self-Driving, which --- if true --- would make his death the first known fatality involving Tesla's most advanced driver-assistance technology.
Tesla owners have long complained of occasionally erratic behavior by the cars' software, including sudden braking, missed road markings and crashes with parked emergency vehicles. Since federal regulators began requiring automakers to report crashes involving driver-assistance systems in 2021, they have logged more than 900 in Teslas.风险控制 A Post analysis found at least 40 crashes that resulted in serious or fatal injuries.
“第一次发生时，我想的是'这正常吗？'”罗西特回忆道，他将丹佛郊外的这段五英里路程描述为“令人不适”。“他说，'是的，这种情况偶尔会发生。'”
Most involved Autopilot, which is designed for use on controlled-access highways. No fatal crash has been definitively linked to the more sophisticated Full Self-Driving, which is programmed to guide the car almost anywhere, from quiet suburban roads to busy city streets.
Two years ago, a Tesla shareholder [tweeted](https://x.com/GerberKawasaki/status/1482809775565926404?s=20&itid=lk_inline_enhanced-template) that there "has not been one accident or injury" involving Full Self-Driving, to which Musk responded: "Correct." But if that was accurate at the time, it no longer appears to be so. A Tesla driver who caused an eight-car [pileup](https://theintercept.com/2023/01/10/tesla-crash-footage-autopilot/?itid=lk_inline_enhanced-template) with multiple injuries on the San Francisco-Oakland Bay Bridge in 2022 told police he was using Full Self-Driving. And The Post has linked the technology to at least two serious crashes, including the one that killed von Ohain.
数小时后，在返程途中，这辆特斯拉Model 3撞上一棵树并起火爆炸，冯·奥恩当场死亡。冯·奥恩是特斯拉员工，也是首席执行官埃隆·马斯克的忠实粉丝。罗西特在事故中幸存下来，据《华盛顿邮报》获得的911调度录音显示，他告诉急救人员，冯·奥恩当时正在使用特斯拉的“自动驾驶功能”，“直接冲出路面”。罗西特在近日的一次采访中表示，他认为冯·奥恩当时正在使用全自动驾驶模式——如果属实，这将使他的死亡成为已知的第一起涉及特斯拉最先进驾驶辅助技术的致命事故。
Von Ohain and Rossiter had been drinking, and an autopsy found that von Ohain died with a blood alcohol level of 0.26 --- more than three times the legal limit --- a level of intoxication that would have hampered his ability to maintain control of the car, experts said. Still, an investigation by the Colorado State Patrol went beyond drunken driving, seeking to understand what role the Tesla software may have played in the crash.
The question is critical as automakers race toward the promise of a driverless future. For private vehicles, that day is far from here. But critics say features like Full Self-Driving already are giving drivers a false sense of confidence about taking their eyes off the road --- or getting behind the wheel after drinking --- evincing the dangers of letting consumers test an evolving, experimental technology on the open road.

Document 3450: Wife of Tesla employee who died in what may have been the first Full Self-Driving crash said she and her husband were 'guinea pigs'
Hans von Ohain, a [Tesla](https://www.businessinsider.com/tesla) recruiter, died in a car crash on a Colorado mountain road after his [Tesla Model 3](https://www.businessinsider.com/how-much-is-a-tesla-model-3) veered off the road and barreled into a tree, bursting into flames, according to a new report from [The Washington Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/interactive/2024/tesla-full-self-driving-fatal-crash/).
汉斯·冯·奥海恩是特斯拉的一名招聘人员，据《华盛顿邮报》的一份新报道，他的特斯拉Model 3偏离道路并撞上一棵树后起火燃烧，他在科罗拉多州一条山路上的一场车祸中丧生。
Erik Rossiter, a friend of Ohain's who was in the vehicle at the time of the 2022 crash and survived the incident, told first responders Ohain had been using the "[auto-drive feature](https://www.businessinsider.com/tesla-features) on the Tesla" and the vehicle "just ran straight off the road," the outlet reported.
If what Rossiter said is true, the incident --- which Tesla has so far refused to acknowledge publicly --- would be the first known [fatality linked to the car company](https://www.businessinsider.com/tesla-deaths)'s Full Self-Driving technology.
奥海恩的朋友埃里克·罗西特在2022年这起事故发生时也在车上并幸存下来，他告诉首批救援人员，奥海恩当时正在使用特斯拉的“自动辅助驾驶功能”，车辆“直接冲出了道路”。
While Ohain had been intoxicated at the time of the crash, with a blood-alcohol level more than three times the legal limit, investigators found the incident was not a typical drunken-driving crash. Sgt. Robert Madden of Colorado State Patrol told the Post there were no skid marks, which would have indicated the vehicle attempted to brake before impact, but there were "rolling tire marks," meaning power was still being deployed to the wheels after the [crash](https://www.businessinsider.com/tesla-autopilot-crashes-activating-unsuitable-roads-regulator2023-12).
Madden said that "given the crash dynamics and how the vehicle drove off the road with no evidence of a sudden maneuver, that fits with the [driver-assistance] feature" being engaged.
如果罗西特的说法属实，这起事故——特斯拉目前拒绝公开承认——将成为首例已知的与特斯拉全自动驾驶技术相关的死亡事故。
Madden also described the subsequent fire, which engulfed the car, as one of the "most intense" vehicle fires he had encountered, due largely to the lithium-ion battery cells housed in the undercarriage of the Tesla that Ohain was driving.
Ohain's cause of death was determined to be smoke inhalation and thermal injuries, per the Post, and Madden said he probably would have survived the crash had it not been for the intensity of the flames.
尽管奥海恩在事故发生时处于醉酒状态，血液酒精含量超过法定上限的三倍，但调查人员发现这起事故并非典型的酒驾事故。科罗拉多州巡逻队的罗伯特·马登中士告诉《华盛顿邮报》，现场没有刹车痕迹——如果有刹车痕迹则表明车辆在撞击前曾试图制动——但发现了“滚动轮胎痕迹”，这意味着在撞击后动力仍在向车轮输出。
Nora Bass, Ohain's widow, told the Post her husband believed in [Elon Musk](https://www.businessinsider.com/elon-musk)'s vision for the future of autonomous vehicles so much that he was willing to tolerate the "jerky" experience to help improve Tesla's self-driving technology.
But since Tesla has so far been silent about Ohain's death, she told the outlet she felt she and her husband were "just guinea pigs" ironing out the kinks in the tech with a false promise of safety.
马登说，“考虑到事故的动态特征以及车辆是如何驶出道路且没有突然转向迹象的，这与辅助驾驶功能被启用的情况相符。”
"Regardless of how drunk Hans was, Musk has claimed that this car can drive itself and is essentially better than a human," Bass told the Post. "We were sold a false sense of security."
Bass and representatives for Tesla didn't immediately respond to a request for comment from Business Insider.
马登还描述了随后吞噬整辆汽车的火灾，称这是他见过的“最剧烈”的车辆火灾之一，主要原因是奥海恩驾驶的特斯拉底盘下方装有锂离子电池。
[Tesla's disclaimer](https://www.tesla.com/support/autopilot) for its current self-driving technology reads: "Autopilot, Enhanced Autopilot, and Full Self-Driving Capability are intended for use with a fully attentive driver, who has their hands on the wheel and is prepared to take over at any moment. While these features are designed to become more capable over time, the currently enabled features do not make the vehicle autonomous."
Tesla's Full Self-Driving capability is still in beta testing.
据《华盛顿邮报》报道，奥海恩的死因被确定为吸入烟雾和热损伤，马登表示，如果没有火焰的剧烈程度，他很可能在撞击中幸存下来。
There have been numerous crashes, some fatal, linked to Tesla's Autopilot technology, which is designed for use on highways, though Tesla has not been found [responsible for the crashes](https://www.businessinsider.com/tesla-autopilot-not-responsible-fatal-crash-jury-finds-elon-musk-2023-11).
But the Full Self-Driving technology --- meant to maneuver Tesla vehicles through nearly any scenario --- has not been definitively tied to any deaths. The Post reported that a Tesla driver who was behind an eight-car pileup causing multiple injuries on the San Francisco-Oakland Bay Bridge in November 2022 said he was using [Full Self-Driving](https://www.businessinsider.com/tesla-crashes-involving-autopilot-mode-soar-since-2019-report-finds-2023-6) and that Ohain's death could be the first known fatality associated with the technology.
奥海恩的遗孀诺拉·巴斯告诉《华盛顿邮报》，她的丈夫非常相信埃隆·马斯克对自动驾驶汽车未来的愿景，以至于他愿意忍受“颠簸”的体验来帮助改进特斯拉的自动驾驶技术。
Document 3454: Tesla Sold ‘False Sense Of Security’ To Employee Killed In Suspected Full Self-Driving Crash
Tesla's [Full Self-Driving software can't drive your car](https://jalopnik.com/tesla-s-self-driving-ambitions-are-further-and-further-1850245462) by itself. Despite its name, the advanced driver assist program [requires drivers keep their eyes on the road](https://jalopnik.com/elon-musk-says-version-12-of-so-called-full-self-drivin-1850586856) at all times and be prepared to [take the wheel at a moment's notice](https://jalopnik.com/americans-are-starting-to-realize-self-driving-cars-are-1851231139). Now, the widow of a driver killed in a crash that involved FSD has accused the automaker of selling a "false sense of security" with the software.
特斯拉的完全自动驾驶软件并不能自动驾驶您的汽车。尽管其名称如此，这个高级驾驶辅助程序要求驾驶员始终注视道路，并随时准备接管方向盘。如今，在一起涉及完全自动驾驶的事故中遇难的驾驶员遗孀，指控这家汽车制造商通过该软件销售了一种“虚假的安全感”。
In 2022, Tesla employee Hans von Ohain was driving his Model 3 electric vehicle alongside Erik Rossiter.受影响方 The pair had been out playing golf one afternoon and had a few drinks before heading home. On the drive back, von Ohain reportedly let his Tesla take control of the ride by initiating its FSD software, [reports the *Washington Post*](https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/interactive/2024/tesla-full-self-driving-fatal-crash/).
However, the drive ended in disaster [when the Model 3](https://jalopnik.com/tesla-model-3-finally-gets-feature-other-cars-have-had-1850826500) careered off the road and burst into flames, killing von Ohain and injuring Rossiter. As the *Post* explains:
2022年，特斯拉员工汉斯·冯·欧海因驾驶着他的Model 3电动汽车，载着埃里克·罗西特。当天下午，两人外出打高尔夫球后，在回家路上喝了几杯。据报道，在返程途中，冯·欧海因启动了完全自动驾驶软件，让他的特斯拉接管了驾驶。
> "The Tesla Model 3 barreled into a tree and exploded in flames, killing von Ohain, a Tesla employee and devoted fan of CEO Elon Musk. Rossiter, who survived the crash, told emergency responders that von Ohain was using an "auto-drive feature on the Tesla" that "just ran straight off the road," according to a 911 dispatch recording obtained by The Washington Post. In a recent interview, Rossiter said he believes that von Ohain was using Full Self-Driving, which --- if true --- would make his death the first known fatality involving Tesla's most advanced driver-assistance technology."
While no crash has so far been definitively linked to the FSD program, the *Post* identified numerous other collisions in which drivers claimed the software was initiated. This included a 2022 crash that [caused a massive pileup in San Francisco](https://jalopnik.com/tesla-in-full-self-driving-mode-caused-8-car-pile-up-r-1849922546) and at least [two serious crashes](https://jalopnik.com/tesla-confirm-automated-driving-engaged-fatal-crash-1850347917), including the crash that killed von Ohain.
然而，当这辆Model 3冲出道路并起火燃烧时，这段旅程以灾难告终，冯·欧海因不幸遇难，罗西特受伤。正如《华盛顿邮报》所解释的：
Von Ohain's crash is complicated, though, as a postmortem following his death revealed that he was three times over the legal blood alcohol limit to drive. Still, police investigating the crash have sought to uncover [the role FSD played](https://jalopnik.com/teslas-promise-of-a-fully-self-driving-car-merely-an-as-1849887546) in von Ohain's death. The *Post* reports:
> Von Ohain's widow, Nora Bass, said she has been unable to find a lawyer willing to take his case to court because he was legally intoxicated. Nonetheless, she said, Tesla should take at least some responsibility for her husband's death.
“特斯拉Model 3撞上一棵树后起火爆炸，冯·欧海因当场死亡，他是特斯拉员工兼首席执行官埃里克·马斯克的忠实粉丝。罗西特在事故中幸存，他告诉紧急救援人员，冯·欧海因当时在使用特斯拉的'自动驾驶功能'，'直接冲出了道路'。根据《华盛顿邮报》获取的911调度录音，在最近的一次采访中，罗西特表示，他认为冯·欧海因当时正在使用完全自动驾驶，如果属实，这将是已知的第一起涉及特斯拉最先进驾驶辅助技术的致命事故。”
>
> "Regardless of how drunk Hans was, Musk has claimed that this car can drive itself and is essentially better than a human," Bass said. "We were sold a false sense of security."
尽管目前没有一起事故被明确认定与完全自动驾驶程序有关，但《华盛顿邮报》发现了多起其他碰撞事故，驾驶员声称当时已启动了完全自动驾驶软件。其中包括2022年在旧金山造成大规模连环撞车的事故，以及至少两起严重碰撞事故，包括导致冯·欧海因遇难的那起事故。
In the aftermath of the crash, investigators found that the [Tesla continued](https://jalopnik.com/tesla-alerted-driver-150-times-to-take-the-wheel-before-1850724778) to feed power to the wheels after impact. They also didn't identify any signs that Von Ohain nor the car itself had applied the brakes to try and stop the Model 3 as it came off the road. This, Colorado State Patrol Sgt. Robert Madden told the *Post, *was a clear sign that "fits with the [driver-assistance] feature being engaged."
Due to the intensity of the fire and the destruction of the car that it cause, Colorado investigators have been unable to access data from the car to [determine if FSD really was engaged](https://jalopnik.com/elon-musk-tesla-self-driving-cars-anniversary-autopilot-1850432357). What's more, Tesla said that it "...could not confirm that a driver-assistance system had been in use because it did not receive data over-the-air for this incident," reports the *Post*.
不过，冯·欧海因的事故情况较为复杂，因为验尸显示，他的血液酒精浓度是法定驾驶上限的三倍。然而，负责调查这起事故的警方仍试图查明完全自动驾驶在他死亡中所起的作用。《华盛顿邮报》报道：
Tesla did report the crash to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration as part of its continued reporting of crashes involving its [Autopilot and FSD systems](https://jalopnik.com/elon-musk-tesla-self-driving-demo-was-a-mess-1850783574). However, NHTSA could not confirm which program was involved in the crash.
Document 3459: Tesla Recruiter's Tragic Death in Colorado Crash Raises Questions About EV's Full Self-Driving Feature
A Tesla recruiter lost his life in a tragic incident in 2022 while using the electric vehicle's (EV) Full Self-Driving (FSD) feature. The fatal accident occurred on a Colorado mountain road when Hans von Ohain's Tesla Model 3 veered off the road, collided with a tree, and subsequently caught fire.
2022年，一名特斯拉招聘人员在使用电动汽车完全自动驾驶（FSD）功能时遭遇悲剧事故丧生。这起致命事故发生在科罗拉多州一条山间公路上，汉斯·冯·奥拜恩的特斯拉Model 3偏离道路，撞上一棵树，随后起火。
Surviving passenger and friend Erik Rossiter informed emergency responders that the victim had activated the "auto-drive feature" before the crash. In a report, The Washington Post wrote that this would be Tesla's first driver-assistance fatality if the incident gets [officially connected with FSD. ](https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/interactive/2024/tesla-full-self-driving-fatal-crash/)Even though von Ohain was legally drunk, officials are investigating Tesla's software's participation in the disaster.
Tesla Driver-Assistance Features Under Scrutiny
幸存乘客兼朋友埃里克·罗西特告诉急救人员，受害者在撞车前已启用"自动驾驶功能"。《华盛顿邮报》在一篇报道中写道，如果该事件与FSD正式关联，这将成为特斯拉首例辅助驾驶致死事故。尽管冯·奥拜恩处于法定醉驾状态，官员们仍在调查特斯拉软件在这场灾难中是否发挥了作用。
-----------------------------------------------
Since 2021, federal officials have recorded over 900 Tesla driver-assistance system crashes, with at least 40 causing serious or fatal injuries. The majority included Tesla's Autopilot, meant for highway use, although full self-driving, intended for more situations, has not been related to any fatalities.
特斯拉驾驶辅助功能受到审查
Tesla calls FSD "beta" but highlights its importance for road safety after releasing it to 400,000 customers.风险源 Tesla user guides listed scenarios where FSD may not work, and the EV manufacturer emphasizes driver control. The reported Tesla accidents cast doubt on autonomous driving and driver-assistance technology safety, emphasizing regulatory attention and the necessity to comprehend changing technology on public roadways.
-----------------------------------------------
Though Tesla has not yet commented on the issue, it warns that Autopilot, Enhanced Autopilot, and Full Self-Driving Capability are designed to be utilized by a fully aware driver, grasping the wheel and r[eady to take control ](https://www.businessinsider.com/tesla-employee-died-full-self-driving-fatal-crash-2024-2)at any time, according to Business Insider. "While these features are designed to become more capable over time, the currently enabled features do not make the vehicle autonomous," Tesla stated.
Is Tesla Deceiving The Public with FSD?
自2021年以来，联邦官员已记录了超过900起特斯拉驾驶辅助系统事故，其中至少40起造成严重或致命伤害。大多数涉及特斯拉的高速公路用自动辅助驾驶系统Autopilot，尽管旨在应对更多场景的完全自动驾驶功能此前尚未与任何致死事故相关联。
---------------------------------------
Hans von Ohain, a Marine veteran and Tesla employee since 2020, was a believer in the potential of Tesla's full self-driving technology and frequently utilized the feature. Given Elon Musk's claims about the technology's capabilities, his widow, Nora Bass, expressed worries about the false sense of security FSD provides, per The Post.
特斯拉称FSD为"测试版"，但在向40万客户发布后强调其对道路安全的重要性。特斯拉用户指南列出了FSD可能无法工作的场景，这家电动汽车制造商强调驾驶员控制。报道的特斯拉事故对自动驾驶和驾驶辅助技术安全性提出了质疑，强调了监管关注以及理解公共道路上不断发展的技术的必要性。
Bass highlighted her struggle to secure legal representation due to her husband's state of intoxication. However, she maintained that Tesla shares some responsibility for her spouse's demise, emphasizing that regardless of Hans's level of intoxication, Musk claimed that the car could operate autonomously and was essentially superior to a human. "We were sold a false sense of security."
Tesla's self-driving claims are under investigation by the government. Despite Elon Musk's [frequent promises](https://www.theverge.com/2023/8/23/23837598/tesla-elon-musk-self-driving-false-promises-land-of-the-giants) regarding autonomous vehicles, Tesla's history is now tainted by the FSD tragedies. One of multiple Tesla lawsuits is led by Nabilah Hussain, a lawyer alleging that the EV firm advertised a non-existent fully self-driving device. "Tesla is marketing and trying to sell you a product that doesn't exist," Hussain said in the article.
尽管特斯拉尚未就此问题发表评论，但据《商业内幕》报道，该公司警告称，自动辅助驾驶、增强版自动辅助驾驶和完全自动驾驶功能仅供完全警觉的驾驶员使用，需手握方向盘并随时准备接管。"虽然这些功能旨在随着时间推移变得更加强大，但当前启用的功能并不能使车辆实现自动驾驶，"特斯拉表示。
Tesla has not officially recognized von Ohain's death, raising issues about the company's duty and contact with employees and their families. The incident highlights persistent technical and ethical concerns around incorporating autonomous driving technology into daily use.

Document 1247: Troy will turn off ShotSpotter
TROY — The cops on the beat, the brass and the mayor all agree that the high-tech listening system that's supposed to identify the location of gunshots is ineffective.
特洛伊市——无论是巡逻警察、警局高层还是市长，都一致认为那个旨在识别枪击位置的高科技监听系统是无效的。
That's why the city has decided to get rid of the ShotSpotter system at the end of the year.
"We are discontinuing Shot-Spotter," Chief [John Tedesco](https://www.timesunion.com/search/?action=search&channel=local&inlineLink=1&searchindex=solr&query=%22John+Tedesco%22) said Tuesday night during the [Public Safety Committee](https://www.timesunion.com/search/?action=search&channel=local&inlineLink=1&searchindex=solr&query=%22Public+Safety+Committee%22)'s review of the police department budget for 2013.
这就是为什么该市决定在年底停用ShotSpotter系统。
Dropping the system means the city will save $39,000 in annual costs. Tedesco said the company had been pressuring the department to upgrade the system, which would have moved monitoring to California instead of in police headquarters.
The displeasure with the acoustic surveillance system is so prevalent that Tedesco and Officer [Robert Fitzgerald](https://www.timesunion.com/search/?action=search&channel=local&inlineLink=1&searchindex=solr&query=%22Robert+Fitzgerald%22), the [Troy Police Benevolent Association](https://www.timesunion.com/search/?action=search&channel=local&inlineLink=1&searchindex=solr&query=%22Troy+Police+Benevolent+Association%22) president, who usually disagree on issues, both agree that it's time is over.
“我们将停用ShotSpotter，”局长约翰·特德斯科周二晚间在公共安全委员会审查警察局2013年预算时表示。
"We're getting a better response from the public," Fitzgerald said about calls residents made to report gunfire.受影响方
The chief and union president said the patrol officers supported dumping ShotSpotter.
放弃该系统意味着该市每年将节省3.9万美元的开支。特德斯科表示，该公司一直向警局施压要求升级系统，而升级本会将监控工作转移至加利福尼亚州，而非保留在警察总部。
Tedesco said the system never achieved what it was suppose to do when the city installed it for $250,000 in 2009 using drug forfeiture money to cover the cost.
"It wasn't reliable," Tedesco said.
对这套声学监控系统的反感非常普遍，以至于平日里在诸多问题上意见相左的特德斯科与特洛伊警察慈善协会主席罗伯特·菲茨杰拉德警官，都一致认为该系统已到了该退场的时候。
It also was expensive, the chief said. Moving one of the listening devices, he said, cost $6,500.
The system was suppose to become attuned to the way sounds were heard in Troy's streets and differentiate among the brakes of a truck climbing the Hoosic Street hill, from a firecracker, actual shots and any other noise.
“公众的反应更好，”菲茨杰拉德在谈到居民拨打枪击报警电话时如是说。
Tedesco said this was never completely achieved.
Mayor [Lou Rosamilia](https://www.timesunion.com/search/?action=search&channel=local&inlineLink=1&searchindex=solr&query=%22Lou+Rosamilia%22) said he backed the decision to end participation in ShotSpotter.
局长和工会主席均表示，巡逻警员支持弃用ShotSpotter。
"It's not working in the way it's suppose to," Rosamilia said.
A ShotSpotter spokeswoman could not be immediately reached Tuesday night for comment.
特德斯科表示，2009年该市利用毒品没收资金出资25万美元安装该系统时，它就从未实现过预期的功能。
Troy installed a network of 22 acoustic listening devices to cover the neighborhoods with the highest crime incidents.
The city rolled out the surveillance devices with great fanfare in late 2008. It was supposed to lead officers to the sites where shots were fired when not reported by the public.
“它不可靠，”特德斯科说。
Rosamilia, Tedesco and Fitzgerald each said that unlike in some cities, Troy residents call in reports of gunshots.
At first, police touted the system as an early success. Each patrol car had access to the computerized monitoring system installed to allow officers to get the information firsthand.
局长还表示，该系统成本也很高。他说，移动其中一个监听设备的费用就高达6500美元。
It was expected to take a full year to fine-tune the acoustic devices so it would pick out the gunshots from other sounds. Tedesco said that never occurred.
The listening devices were placed to cover an area that ran from Lansingburgh south through downtown and into South Troy. The system also picked up sounds from the [Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute](https://www.timesunion.com/search/?action=search&channel=local&inlineLink=1&searchindex=solr&query=%22Rensselaer+Polytechnic+Institute%22) campus.
该系统本应适应特洛伊街道上的声音特征，并区分爬霍西克街山坡的卡车刹车声、鞭炮声、真实的枪声以及其他任何噪音。
Retired Chief [Nicholas Kaiser](https://www.timesunion.com/search/?action=search&channel=local&inlineLink=1&searchindex=solr&query=%22Nicholas+Kaiser%22) pushed for the installation of the system, which was supported by former Mayor [Harry Tutunjian](https://www.timesunion.com/search/?action=search&channel=local&inlineLink=1&searchindex=solr&query=%22Harry+Tutunjian%22).
Document 2626: Controversial ShotSpotter gunshot detection technology failed to pick up two recent deadly shootings in Durham
A pair of deadly shootings [recently](https://www.cbs17.com/news/local-news/durham-county-news/durham-police-did-not-receive-shotspotter-alerts-in-recent-deadly-shootings-officers-say/) went undetected by ShotSpotter, the [controversial](https://www.dukechronicle.com/article/2022/10/durham-shotspotter-pilot-controversial-gunshot-detection-technology-in-november-community-members-express-concerns) gunshot detection technology currently being piloted by the city of Durham. A spokesperson for the Durham Police Department [told](https://www.cbs17.com/news/local-news/durham-county-news/durham-police-did-not-receive-shotspotter-alerts-in-recent-deadly-shootings-officers-say/) CBS17 that police did not receive an alert for a Feb. 5 [shooting](https://www.cbs17.com/news/local-news/durham-county-news/1-shot-and-killed-in-durham-neighborhood-police-say/) at Fay and Juniper Streets and a [shooting](https://www.cbs17.com/news/local-news/durham-county-news/durham-police-investigating-fatal-shooting-on-park-avenue/) last Thursday on Park Avenue. Both shootings resulted in two total deaths.
最近发生的两起致命枪击案未被ShotSpotter侦测到，这是达勒姆市目前正在试点的这项备受争议的枪声侦测技术。达勒姆警察局发言人告知CBS17，警方没有收到关于2月5日发生在Fay街和Juniper街交汇处的枪击案以及上周四发生在Park Avenue的枪击案的警报。这两起枪击案共造成两人死亡。
These reports come a month after a drive-by [shooting](https://www.dukechronicle.com/article/2023/01/durham-shotspotter-technology-failed-to-notify-police-of-new-years-day-drive-by-shooting) on New Year’s Day that injured five people also went undetected by ShotSpotter. All three shootings fell within the three square miles that Shotspotter was monitoring. The area [represents](https://www.dukechronicle.com/article/2022/10/durham-shotspotter-pilot-controversial-gunshot-detection-technology-in-november-community-members-express-concerns) only 2.7% of the total landmass of the city, but accounts for roughly one in three gunshot wounds.
Durham Mayor Pro Tempore Mark-Anthony Middleton, an early [advocate](https://www.dukechronicle.com/article/2022/04/shotspotter-durham-chicago-charlotte-gun-violence-prevention-technology) for piloting the technology in Durham, defended its continued usage. He [said](https://www.cbs17.com/news/local-news/durham-county-news/durham-police-did-not-receive-shotspotter-alerts-in-recent-deadly-shootings-officers-say/) to CBS17 that it was important to “look at all of the data” given the initiative is currently only two months into the year-long pilot.
这些报告发布前一个月，元旦当天发生的一起造成五人受伤的驾车枪击案也未被ShotSpotter侦测到。这三起枪击案均发生在ShotSpotter监测的三平方英里区域内。该区域仅占全市总面积的2.7%，但约占枪伤案件的三分之一。
“Any specific data point where we miss something is bothersome and disturbing, but we have to keep in mind that this is a piece of technology. My cell phone dropped a call last week, I’m not throwing my cell phone out.” Middleton [told](https://www.cbs17.com/news/local-news/durham-county-news/durham-police-did-not-receive-shotspotter-alerts-in-recent-deadly-shootings-officers-say/) CBS17.
According to its monthly [report](https://www.cbs17.com/news/local-news/durham-county-news/durham-police-did-not-receive-shotspotter-alerts-in-recent-deadly-shootings-officers-say/) for January, ShotSpotter sent the Durham Police 197 alerts, detecting 998 rounds fired. In its [contract](https://www.newsobserver.com/news/local/crime/article265506381.html) with the city, ShotSpotter commits to detecting and locating 90% of unsuppressed outdoor gunfire when the fired rounds are above .25 caliber.
达勒姆临时市长马克-安东尼·米德尔顿曾是达勒姆试点该技术的早期支持者，他为其继续使用进行了辩护。他对CBS17表示，鉴于该项目目前仅处于为期一年的试点期的第二个月，重要的是“查看所有数据”。
Durham County [began](https://www.newsobserver.com/news/local/counties/durham-county/article269993447.html) its one-year pilot of ShotSpotter last December. The system relies on sensors placed on buildings that can flag sounds that might be gunfire or explosions. The audio is then sent to ShotSpotter’s “Incident Review Center” where it is manually confirmed. Pollice can then be sent to the area.
“We are sending our deepest condolences to the community impacted by the recent shooting that took place in Durham, NC. We have investigated the situation and provided a report to the Durham Police Department,” the company [wrote](https://www.cbs17.com/news/local-news/durham-county-news/durham-police-did-not-receive-shotspotter-alerts-in-recent-deadly-shootings-officers-say/) in a statement.
“任何我们漏掉的具体数据点都令人烦恼和不安，但我们必须记住这是一项技术。上周我的手机掉线了，但我并没有把手机扔掉。”米德尔顿告诉CBS17。
Last September, the Durham school board [voted](https://www.newsobserver.com/news/local/counties/durham-county/article266235211.html) to prohibit ShotSpotter from installing its sensors on school campuses. One board member deemed it an “item of surveillance.” Local residents have also [raised](https://www.dukechronicle.com/article/2022/10/durham-shotspotter-pilot-controversial-gunshot-detection-technology-in-november-community-members-express-concerns) concerns that the technology may result in an increased police presence that could make racial profiling a more prevalent issue.
Document 3844: Gunshot Detection System Wastes N.Y.P.D. Officers’ Time, Audit Finds
ShotSpotter, a system the Police Department uses to detect gunfire, is overwhelmingly inaccurate and leads officers to spend hundreds of hours each month investigating nonexistent shots风险源, according to an [audit the New York City comptroller released Thursday](https://comptroller.nyc.gov/reports/audit-report-on-the-new-york-city-police-departments-oversight-of-its-agreement-with-shotspotter-inc-for-the-gunshot-detection-and-location-system/#_ftn5).
据纽约市审计长周四发布的一份审计报告显示，警方用于侦测枪声的ShotSpotter系统极其不准确，导致警员每月花费数百小时调查根本不存在的枪击事件。
The Police Department has spent more than $45 million on ShotSpotter since it [started using it in 2015](https://www.nytimes.com/2015/03/17/nyregion/shotspotter-detection-system-pinpoints-gunshot-locations-and-sends-data-to-the-police.html), even as cities around the country have stopped using the system. New York must decide before December whether to renew its contract with SoundThinking, the California company that owns the system, and the audit advises officials to decline until the system can be fully evaluated.
Auditors studied ShotSpotter's accuracy over several months in 2022 and 2023. When it was performing at its best, only 20 percent of ShotSpotter's alerts actually revealed shootings, they found. Often, it did even worse. Of the 940 alerts officers responded to last June, only 13 percent corresponded to confirmed shootings.
自2015年开始使用ShotSpotter以来，警方已在该系统上花费超过4500万美元，尽管全美各地已有城市停止使用该系统。纽约必须在12月之前决定是否与拥有该系统的加州公司SoundThinking续签合同，而审计报告建议官员在对该系统进行全面评估之前拒绝续约。
And in 2022, the audit found, the system also failed to detect more than 200 real incidents of gunfire in Manhattan.
The Police Department "is wasting precious time and money on this technology and needs to do a better job managing its resources," the comptroller, Brad Lander, said in a statement. "Chasing down car backfires and construction noise does not make us safer."
审计人员对ShotSpotter在2022年和2023年数月间的准确性进行了研究。他们发现，即使在该系统表现最佳的时候，也只有20%的警报最终证实是枪击事件。通常情况下，其表现甚至更差。在去年6月警员响应的940起警报中，只有13%对应了经证实的枪击事件。
Several [major cities](https://www.cnn.com/2024/02/24/us/shotspotter-cities-choose-not-to-use/index.html) have moved away from ShotSpotter in recent years and others are grappling with whether to renew contracts that will expire this year. Chicago's mayor [campaigned](https://www.cbsnews.com/chicago/news/shotspotter-ordinance-delayed-city-council-mayor-brandon-johnson/) on a promise to jettison the technology and blamed it for the death of an unarmed 13-year old shot by [officers responding to an](https://theintercept.com/2021/04/13/chicago-police-killing-boy-adam-toledo-shotspotter/) alert in 2021. In Boston, the mayor and the police department are [on the defensive](https://www.bostonherald.com/2024/05/24/amid-pushback-boston-mayor-wu-backs-police-use-of-shotspotter-technology/) after three members of the state's congressional delegation [signed a letter](https://www.bostonherald.com/2024/05/14/warren-markey-pressley-follow-boston-police-review-by-pressing-for-federal-probe-of-shotspotter/) that called for a national probe into the system.
The Police Department's press office declined to comment Thursday, referring to a response to the audit in which the department disputed some aspects of the report, saying that the comptroller's office had classified reports as unfounded if investigators found no physical evidence of gunfire. But that, the department said, did not mean shootings had not happened.
此外，审计发现，2022年该系统还未能侦测到曼哈顿发生的200多起真实枪击事件。
A spokeswoman for Mayor Eric Adams, Kayla Mamelak, called ShotSpotter "one of many tools we use to help fight crime to keep our city safe."
"While we understand that emerging technologies evolve and there is always room for improvement, what seems to be lost on the comptroller is that ShotSpotter has given the N.Y.P.D. the ability to solve countless crimes and save lives," she said in a statement.
审计长布拉德·兰德在一份声明中表示：“警方正在这项技术上浪费宝贵的时间和金钱，并且需要更好地管理其资源。追踪汽车回火声和建筑噪音并不能让我们更安全。”
In a statement Thursday, Jerome Filip, a spokesman for SoundThinking, dismissed the audit as a "gravely misinformed in its assessment of data" and said it emphasized the wrong metrics for evaluating the tool.
The company's shares [have lost nearly half their value](https://ir.soundthinking.com/stock-info/quote) this year.
近年来，已有几个主要城市弃用了ShotSpotter，其他城市也在纠结是否续签将于今年到期的合同。芝加哥市长在竞选时承诺摒弃该技术，并指责其导致了一名手无寸铁的13岁少年在2021年因警员响应警报而被枪杀。在波士顿，在该州国会代表团的三名成员签署联名信呼吁对该系统进行全国性调查后，市长和警方正处于守势。
ShotSpotter uses sensors that are installed across all five boroughs in New York. The devices listen for sharp, loud sounds and transmit data to staff members who determine whether they sound like gunshots and notify the police. According to [SoundThinking's website](https://www.soundthinking.com/law-enforcement/leading-gunshot-detection-system/), the process should take around a minute.
The audit said that most reports were erroneous and that officers rarely determined what had triggered false alarms. Common culprits are fireworks and street noise, it said. Those false alerts are costly: Officers spent almost 427 hours investigating unconfirmed reports in a single month, the audit found.
警方新闻办公室周四拒绝置评，而是引用了其对审计报告的回应。在该回应中，警方对报告的某些方面提出了异议，称审计长办公室在调查人员未发现枪击实物证据的情况下，就将报告归类为无根据。但警方表示，这并不意味着枪击事件没有发生。
The audit suggested that such fruitless work might be contributing to the [ballooning millions of dollars in overtime](https://comptroller.nyc.gov/reports/overtime-overview/) that police officers claim each year. The Police Department disputed that, saying that only officers who are already on the clock respond to ShotSpotter alerts.
Civil liberties [groups say](https://www.aclu.org/news/privacy-technology/four-problems-with-the-shotspotter-gunshot-detection-system) that the listening devices, which are concentrated in areas where shootings often occur, can lead to overpolicing in low-income neighborhoods that are predominantly home to people of color. The groups also say that prosecutors use the system's questionable data to construct flimsy cases against people who have been accused of wrongdoing.
市长埃里克·亚当斯的发言人凯拉·马梅拉克称ShotSpotter是“我们用来打击犯罪、维护城市安全的众多工具之一”。
Daniel Schwarz, a technology and privacy strategist for the New York Civil Liberties Union, said that he hoped the audit would start a conversation about how the technology is used in New York.
"We know already that these sensors are primarily deployed in communities of color --- and we also know from the tragic killing in Chicago of Adam Toledo that ShotSpotter can escalate police violence," said Mr. Schwarz, adding that "it's on the N.Y.P.D. to really justify their reasoning behind the technology and why that technology is needed*."*
她在一份声明中表示：“虽然我们明白新兴技术会不断发展，且总有改进空间，但审计长似乎忽略了这一点：ShotSpotter赋予了纽约警方侦破无数案件和挽救生命的能力。”
In its response, the department said that letting the contract lapse would result in a "less safe working environment for officers and an increased chance of violent encounters for all New Yorkers."

Document 2502: Vanderbilt University uses ChatGPT to address MSU shooting: ‘Sick’
Tennessee’s Vanderbilt University apologized after it used ChatGPT to write a nonsensical email addressing the deadly Michigan State University shooting — which students have blasted as “twisted.”
田纳西州范德堡大学在使用ChatGPT撰写了一封关于密歇根州立大学枪击案的毫无意义的邮件后道歉，学生们痛批这封邮件“令人恶心”。
The bizarre email, sent out Thursday by the Nashville institution’s Peabody Office of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, made no mention of Vanderbilt-specific resources students could contact for support — and instead included several repetitive paragraphs offering vague thoughts about “creating a safe and inclusive environment.”
It also refers to “recent Michigan shootings,” when there was only one incident, according to the Vanderbilt Hustler, [which first reported the story](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/).
这封奇怪的邮件于周四由该校位于纳什维尔的皮博迪公平、多元与包容办公室发出，邮件中没有提及任何范德堡大学学生可以联系的支持资源，而是包含了几段重复的内容，表达了一些关于“创造安全包容环境”的模糊想法。
At the bottom of the email — in much smaller type — a line reads “Paraphrase from OpenAI’s ChatGPT AI language model, personal communication, February 15, 2023.”
Laith Kayat, a senior at Vanderbilt who is from Michigan and has a younger sister who attends MSU, told the student newspaper it was impersonal and lacked empathy.
邮件中还提到了“最近密歇根州的枪击事件”，但实际上只有一起事件。据范德堡大学校报《Vanderbilt Hustler》最先报道了这一事件。
“There’s a sick and twisted irony to making a computer write your message about community and togetherness because you can’t be bothered to reflect on it yourself,” Kayat said.
“\\[Administrators\\] only care about perception and their institutional politics of saving face.”
邮件底部以小得多的字体写着：“改编自OpenAI的ChatGPT AI语言模型，个人交流，2023年2月15日。”
Samuel Lu, a sophomore, told the paper he felt that using ChatGPT was disrespectful to gun violence victims.受影响方
“It’s hard to take a message seriously when I know that the sender didn’t even take the time to put their genuine thoughts and feelings into words,” Lu said. “In times of tragedies such as this, we need more, not less humanity.”
范德堡大学高年级学生莱恩·卡亚特来自密歇根州，他的妹妹在密歇根州立大学就读。他告诉校报，这封邮件缺乏人情味，没有同理心。
Nicole Joseph, the associate dean for the Office of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, said the decision to use ChatGPT to write the email was made in “poor judgment.”
“While we believe in the message of inclusivity expressed in the email, using ChatGPT to generate communications on behalf of our community in a time of sorrow and in response to a tragedy contradicts the values that characterize Peabody College,” Joseph apologized in a follow-up email.
卡亚特说：“用电脑来写关于社区和团结的信息，因为你们懒得自己去思考，这真是种病态而扭曲的讽刺。”
“As with all new technologies that affect higher education, this moment gives us all an opportunity to reflect on what we know and what we still must learn about AI.”
[In a statement,](https://peabody.vanderbilt.edu/statement.php) Peabody College’s dean of education and human development, Camilla P. Benbow, said her office is reviewing what happened.
“【管理人员】只在乎表面形象和他们维护面子的机构政治。”
Both Joseph and assistant dean Hasina Mohyuddin will step back from their work in the meantime.
Benbow noted that the development and distribution of the initial email did not follow the school’s normal protocols, which generally include multiple layers of review before being sent.
大二学生塞缪尔·卢告诉校报，他认为使用ChatGPT对枪击案受害者是不尊重的。
“The university’s administrators, including myself, were unaware of the email before it was sent,” Benbow wrote.
“I am also deeply troubled that a communication from my administration so missed the crucial need for personal connection and empathy during a time of tragedy,” Benbow continued.
卢说：“当我得知发送者甚至没有花时间将自己的真实想法和感受表达出来时，很难认真对待这样的信息。在这样的悲剧时刻，我们需要更多的而不是更少的人文关怀。”
“I intend that we shall redouble our efforts to express the values that animate our mission and lead to human flourishing. And I offer my heartfelt apologies to all those who deserved better from us and did not receive it.”
Document 2504: Vanderbilt staff used ChatGPT to write email to students about MSU shooting
[Vanderbilt University](/topic/vanderbilt-university) staff have apologized for using [ChatGPT](/topic/chatgpt) to write a condolence email in the wake of the [Michigan State University](/topic/michigan-state-university) shooting that saw three students murdered.
范德堡大学工作人员已就使用ChatGPT撰写慰问邮件一事道歉，此前密歇根州立大学发生枪击事件，造成三名学生遇害。
Officials at the Office of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion at Peabody College admitted “poor judgement” in using the OpenAI chatbot for the email.
“The recent [Michigan](/topic/michigan) shootings are a tragic reminder of the importance of taking care of each other, particularly in the context of creating inclusive environments,” [read the initial email](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/) from the university’s school of education.
皮博迪学院多元化与包容事务办公室的官员承认，使用OpenAI聊天机器人撰写邮件是“判断失误”。
And it added: “As members of the Peabody campus community, we must reflect on the impact of such an event and take steps to ensure that we are doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment for all.”
At the bottom of the email was a note stating, “Paraphrase from OpenAI’s ChatGPT.” ChatGPT is an AI language model that writes human-sounding but computer-generated text.
这封来自该校教育学院的邮件写道：“近期密歇根州的枪击事件悲惨地提醒我们，彼此关爱的重要性，尤其是在创建包容性环境方面。”
The email brought an angry response from students at the Nashville-based university.
“There is a sick and twisted irony to making a computer write your message about community and togetherness because you can’t be bothered to reflect on it yourself,” Laith Kayat, a senior student whose sister attends Michigan State University, [told _The Vanderbilt Hustler_.](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/)
邮件还写道：“作为皮博迪校园社区的成员，我们必须反思此类事件的影响，并采取措施确保我们尽最大努力为所有人创造一个安全包容的环境。”
An associate dean at Peabody later apologized in a follow-up email, according to the college newspaper.
“While we believe in the message of inclusivity expressed in the email, using ChatGPT to generate communications on behalf of our community in a time of sorrow and in response to a tragedy contradicts the values that characterize Peabody College,” [stated Nicole Joseph.](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/)
邮件底部注明：“内容改编自OpenAI的ChatGPT。”ChatGPT是一款能够生成逼真人声但由计算机生成的文本的AI语言模型。
“As with all new technologies that affect higher education, this moment gives us all an opportunity to reflect on what we know and what we still must learn about AI.”
The 43-year-old man accused of killing three and wounding five in a [shooting at Michigan State University](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/crime/msu-shooting-anthony-mcrae-active-latest-b2282025.html) before turning the gun on himself was found with a note detailing threats to two other schools, authorities say.
这封邮件引起了该校学生的强烈不满。
Police identified the gunman in Monday’s shooting as Anthony McRae. He is not believed to have any connection to MSU.
_The Independent_ has reached out to Vanderbilt University and Peabody College for comment.

**WARNING: This story discusses details of sexual abuse**

When science teacher Hannah Grundy started receiving emails from a stranger called John Doe, she assumed it was a scam and decided to ignore them.受影响方
The messages were warning her that her image had appeared on a website, and urged her to take action to get the pictures taken down.
当科学老师汉娜·格兰迪开始收到一位名叫“约翰·多伊”的陌生人的电子邮件时，她以为这是诈骗，决定不予理会。
She dismissed the strange email, until she got another from someone called Sally who claimed to be another victim.
That email had a link with a warning about ["disturbing material"](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/hacked-deepfake-videos-of-kiwi-women-used-to-scam-friends-and-followers-out-of-thousands/BBUZBV7PJFGHLF74T3NR3QJCAM/).
这些邮件警告她，她的照片出现在了一个网站上，并敦促她采取行动将照片撤下。
"That email freaked me out," Hannah told Australian Story.
She asked her partner Kris to open the link for her while she watched on. "He kind of just went white," she said. Kris then turned to Hannah and said "oh f**k, it's real".
她原本对这些奇怪的邮件不以为意，直到她收到另一封来自一位名叫萨莉的人的邮件，对方声称自己是另一名受害者。
On the link was [photo after photo of Hannah's face](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/revenge-porn-one-womans-years-long-struggle-for-acc-to-recognise-the-harm/BHTOMIENB5HCJO45TDQNVPTLB4/) superimposed on pornographic images.
At the top of the page was a poll where people were voting on their preferred way to rape Hannah.
那封邮件里有一个链接，提示内容包含“令人不安的材料”。
"There were hundreds and hundreds of votes," said Kris.
According to the Daily Mail, the website was found by a New Zealand private investigator who alerted the couple of the danger its contents had put Hannah in.
“那封邮件把我吓坏了，”汉娜告诉《澳大利亚故事》栏目。
The website listed Hannah's full name and Instagram page, and that she lived in Sydney.
Some of the pictures were incredibly graphic and [used AI technology ](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/technology/how-to-spot-ai-generated-deepfake-images/VSTFVQTYJBAEFKU4FONSG5XPSE/)to add features such as bruising.
她让伴侣克里斯帮她打开链接，自己在旁边看着。“他脸色一下子变白了，”她说。克里斯随后转向汉娜说，“哦，该死，这是真的。”
Hannah realised that the pictures had been taken from her Facebook and Instagram, which were both private, meaning that the person behind the deepfake images was one of her mates.
There were also pictures on the website of some of Hannah's very close friends.
链接打开后，是一张又一张将汉娜的面部移植到色情图片上的照片。
One was Rachel McGinty and another was Jessica Stuart, who had both worked at a university bar with Hannah and her partner Kris, and were part of their tight-knit friendship group.

"It was obvious to us that the culprit had some connection to Manning Bar [at the University of Sydney] but we thought it might be a patron," said Kris.
“有成百上千条投票，”克里斯说。
Hannah and Kris turned into online detectives, running the names of the women through Facebook to see which[ mutual friends ](https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/politics/revenge-porn-law-change-to-criminalise-posting-intimate-recordings-without-consent-backed-by-all-parties/HMK6ICHRE6IODWHVCEMM46WNJA/)they all had in common.
The list of mutual friends got smaller and smaller until it could have only been one person.
据《每日邮报》报道，该网站是由一名新西兰私家侦探发现的，他提醒这对夫妇，网站内容已将汉娜置于危险之中。
"It became more and more obvious that it was our friend Andy," said Kris.
Andy Hayler was a supervisor at Manning Bar when Hannah started there as a student.
网站上列出了汉娜的全名和Instagram主页，以及她居住在悉尼的信息。
"I thought of him as a very good friend," said Hannah.
"It was so shocking because Andy was someone we trusted so much. He's been to our house. We've been on holidays with him.
有些图片非常露骨，并利用AI技术添加了诸如淤青等特征。
"A lot of the big moments of our lives over the past 10 years have been with him there.

“我立刻想到，‘这个人是怎么弄到我这些照片的？’我当了十多年的高中老师，所以我的社交媒体已经封锁了13年。我马上意识到，一定是我认识的人。而且仅仅知道这个人显然是我的朋友之一，就让人感到恐惧，尽管我从未想过这会是一个离我很近的人。”
-----------------------------
With the truth uncovered, Hannah and Kris took their evidence to the police, expecting swift action. But that wasn't the case; the police did absolutely nothing at first, leaving Hannah and her partner to take action themselves.
背叛者浮出水面。
"I thought we could just hand it all in, and the police would act right away. It was obvious it was him. We had all the evidence; screenshots, photos, everything. But after spending the entire day giving a statement, we left thinking something was going to happen, but... nothing happened," Hannah said.
For months, Andy continued posting threats about Hannah. "I had to keep him as a friend on social media so he wouldn't know we were onto him. He was still posting, saying things like, 'I know where she lives, I live close to her, I know where she works, and I'm closing in on the slut.' It ramped up, and that freaked us out."
汉娜并不是唯一一个照片被用于那个仇恨网站的女性。为了查明幕后黑手，汉娜和克里斯开始了自己的调查，仔细地缩小嫌疑人范围。
Despite the mounting threats, the police were very slow to act. "We were absolutely desperate, and he started posting about other close friends of ours. The stress was unbearable, so we hired lawyers to put pressure on the police. It cost us a huge amount of money. Even then, nothing happened until we hired a private investigator."
The private investigator confirmed what Hannah and Kris already knew: it was Andy. The investigator simply repackaged the evidence Hannah had put together and sent it to the police. Finally, the wheels of justice began to turn.
“我们开始浏览帖子，查看这个人发布了关于其他女性的内容。我们记下了所有名字，在Facebook上搜索她们，并开始交叉比对我们要共同认识的人。我们整理了一个电子表格，我们与这些女性共同认识的男性群体变得越来越小。最终，我们锁定了三个人。”
"About five days after the private investigator sent his report, the police contacted us to say the case had been assigned to a detective. Two weeks later, they raided Andy's house. They seized all his devices; computers, hard drives, phones, and found everything. He had all of our photos on every device he owned."
**The Extent of Hayler's Crimes**
汉娜意识到只有一个人可能对此负责；那个发现令人崩溃。肯定不会是那个一直作为密友和导师的人吧？
---------------------------------
What the police uncovered during the raid was sickening. Andrew Thomas Hayler had been using social media photos of his victims, superimposing their faces onto explicit pornographic images, and uploading these altered images to an Instagram account and a pornographic website with over 300,000 members.
“我们推断出这只能是我们的密友安迪。他真的是我们要好、最信任的朋友之一。我和伴侣在悉尼大学的曼宁酒吧与他共事了六年。他曾是我的主管，也是我的导师，培训我成为经理。我完全信任他，克里斯也是。发现竟然是他，这个长期以来一直是我们生活一部分的人竟然是幕后黑手——这简直是毁灭性的。”
In addition to Hannah, there were 26 other victims, many of whom were his close friends, former housemates, and colleagues. The posts were often accompanied by violent rape fantasies and graphic descriptions of how the women should be assaulted. In some cases, he published their full names, occupations, and suburbs, inviting other users to comment on how they would rape them.
"I can't even begin to describe the feeling of knowing that someone I trusted so much was doing this," Hannah said. "He wasn't just targeting me, he was targeting strong, successful women. Every woman he went after had a career, goals, and intelligence. But why he fixated on me more than the others... I'll never know."
安德鲁·托马斯·海勒可能曾是汉娜十多年来最信任的朋友之一，但在友谊的伪装背后，他策划了一场长达两年的网络虐待行动，目标针对汉娜和至少其他25名女性。但通往正义的过程漫长得不必要，如果不是汉娜如此努力地推动，施虐者可能仍然逍遥法外。
In 2022, Hayler pleaded guilty to 28 counts of using a carriage service to cause offense, involving 26 women over a two-year period. Seven of these women, including Hannah, provided victim impact statements at his sentencing. Hayler received a landmark sentence of nine years in prison, five of which are without parole.
**The cost of justice.**
漫长的正义之路。
------------------------
Although justice was served, the emotional and financial toll on Hannah has been immense. "What I've learned from this is that if you don't have the money or contacts, you don't get justice. We spent over $20,000 just to push the police to do their job. Without that, Andy would still be out there posting about me."
真相大白后，汉娜和克里斯将证据交给警方，期待能迅速采取行动。但事实并非如此；警方起初毫无作为，留给汉娜和她的伴侣自己去采取行动。
Even with Hayler behind bars, the experience has left scars. "I never got to speak to him, even in court. When we went to his sentencing, he looked at my partner, Kris, and told him he was sorry, but he ignored me. I'll never fully understand why he did it. I'll never get the answers I need. And now we've been told he is appealing his sentence."
Reflecting on the ordeal, Hannah remains hopeful that sharing her story will highlight the need for change. "There are new laws now, with stricter sentences for these kinds of crimes, but it shouldn't take spending thousands of dollars and years of stress just to get justice. This could happen to anyone, and the system needs to do better."
“我以为我们只要把证据交上去，警方就会立刻行动。很明显就是他。我们要有所有的证据；截图、照片，一切。但在花了一整天时间做笔录后，我们离开时以为会有所行动，但……什么也没发生，”汉娜说。
_You can watch Hannah's story on AUSTRALIAN STORY on_ [_ABC iView_](https://iview.abc.net.au/show/australian-story/series/2024)_._
